prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: transparent 4 by 4 animation spritesheet of ONE exact 5BMath Eagle.
References: image 1 species identity ONLY bottom-left cell (row 2 column 1), image 2 material/style reference only. Preserve cream head with scalloped feather collar, warm dark-brown rounded body, two brown wings, curved golden beak, two golden feet with soft rounded claws, one short pale-tipped tail, large warm brown eyes and apricot cheeks. Soft tactile matte clay/felt toy, warm light. No clothes, props or extra limbs.
Exactly 16 separate full-body Eagle poses in equal 4x4 cells, left to right top to bottom. Square sheet, ideally 2048x2048, each character same scale centered, generous transparent margins in every cell to prevent clipping wings. Facing screen-right three-quarter view throughout. No other animals, no text/numbers/grid lines, no background, real alpha transparency. Do not draw any effects, winds, streaks or shadows into sprites.
Row 1 preparation: 1 alert neutral wings lowered, 2 body crouches wings swept back, 3 wings rising above shoulders, 4 deep takeoff wings broad.
Row 2 aerial ascent: 5 airborne wing downstroke feet tucked, 6 wings raised ascending, 7 soaring wings broad, 8 high hovering wings arched.
Row 3 decisive dive and braking: 9 body tilts forward wings folded partway, 10 descending forward diagonal wings swept back, 11 dramatically opens both wings to brake facing right, 12 full proud wings extended, feet coming forward for landing.
Row 4 victory landing: 13 soft landing both feet, 14 proud wings raised V, 15 friendly happy small wing wave with other wing lowered, 16 stable proud final stance wings half open.
Anatomy invariant: exactly two wings total, no separate arms, two feet and one tail in every pose, fully within each cell. Match the actual eagle reference and style closely.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: second transparent 4x4 Eagle animation spritesheet. Use actual Eagle bottom-left cell in first reference as exact species identity, second reference is soft matte clay/felt material and warm lighting style only. Cream feather head and collar, brown body and exactly TWO brown wings, large brown eyes, apricot cheeks, hooked golden beak, TWO golden feet, ONE pale-tipped short tail. Same right-facing three-quarter view, same scale in every cell, same round friendly toy proportions. Exactly 16 separate full body poses, four equal rows by four columns on square image with REAL alpha transparent background, no text/grid/shadow/effects. Keep generous margin in every cell and do not clip wings.
Row1 idle (4 subtle loop poses): neutral friendly wings down, breathe gently wings partway, soft blink wings down, return neutral.
Row2 NORMAL ATTACK (4 poses): crouch wings back, quick short hop toward right wings lifted, broad forward gust-making wing downstroke with determined friendly face, recover both feet on ground. No weapons or injury.
Row3 HIT REACTION (4 poses): startled wide eyes wings out, slight backward body recoil eyes squeezed shut, soft crouch wings tucked with worried eyebrows, steady recovering with small concerned expression. No bruises, wounds, bandages, stars or effect objects.
Row4 SAD DEFEAT (4 poses): head begins lowering wings droop, seated on feet with head lowered and eyes downcast, eyes closed in disappointment wings soft on sides, quiet seated final pose head bowed but unharmed. CLEARLY visibly sad, no smiling. No crying liquids, no text.
Ensure anatomy consistent and exactly two wings with no separate arms, two feet and single tail. Match actual Eagle, not an owl or sparrow.

scope: User explicitly requested eagle game integration, local commit and local deployment on 2026-11-11; supersedes demo-only scope for eagle only.
